Short_Description:
LAND SPEEDER and STORM SPEEDER units gain SPEEDER. 
First Movement phase: SPEEDER units can make an ingress move.
Long_Description:
Friendly LAND SPEEDER/STORM SPEEDER HAILSTRIKE/STORM SPEEDER HAMMERSTRIKE/STORM SPEEDER THUNDERSTRIKE units have SPEEDER.

In your first Movement phase, friendly SPEEDER units can make an ingress move.

Short_Description:
Cover & -1 To be Hit
Aethon: ONCE Free Into the Darkness.
Long_Description:
Each time a ranged attack targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army, unless the attacking model is within 12", subtract 1 from the Hit roll and the target has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Once per battle round, if an AETHON SHAAN model from your army is on the battlefield, you can use the Into Darkness Stratagem for 0CP.

Short_Description: Units can charge after Advancing or Falling Back. SUBODEN KHAN can move up to 6" after destroying an enemy unit in the Fight phase.
Long_Description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

At the end of the Fight phase, if a SUBODEN KHAN unit from your army destroyed one or more enemy units this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: Your army can include WHITE SCARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

Short_Description: Advance or Fallback and Charge.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

Short_Description:
Marneus can select a doctrine a 2nd time

Devastator: Adv and Shoot.
Tactical: Fallback, Shoot and Charge
Assault: Adv and Charge.
Long_Description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Combat Doctrines listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active and its effects apply to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. You cannot select a Combat Doctrine you have already selected this battle, unless a friendly Marneus Calgar model is on the battlefield.

Devastator Doctrine: This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.
Tactical Doctrine: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Assault Doctrine: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Short_Description: Plasma weapon profiles have +1 S.
Long_Description: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units' weapon profiles with 'Plasma' in their names are plasma weapon profiles. Plasma weapon profiles have +1 S.

Short_Description:
Re-rolls 1s To Wound vs Oath
Re-roll all To Wound with Lysander
Long_Description:
Each time a model from your army with the Oath of Moment ability makes an attack that targets your Oath of Moment target, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Each time a model in a DARNATH LYSANDER unit from your army makes an attack that targets your Oath of Moment target, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Short_Description:
Devastator: Adv and Shoot.
Tactical: Fallback, Shoot and Charge
Assault: Adv and Charge.
Long_Description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Combat Doctrines listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active and its effects apply to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. You can only select each Combat Doctrine once per battle.

Devastator Doctrine: This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.
Tactical Doctrine: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Assault Doctrine: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Short_Description:
Oath Target: Re-roll 1s To Wound
Caanok: 2nd Oath Target (Visible)
Long_Description:
Each time a model from your army with the Oath of Moment ability makes an attack that targets your Oath of Moment target, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Once per battle round, after your Oath of Moment target is destroyed, if a Caanok Var model from your army is on the battlefield, select one enemy unit visible to that model. That enemy unit becomes your Oath of Moment target until you select a new one.

Short_Description: Vowed Target (Objective): Defensive (Control) or Aggressive (No Control)    Deathwing INFANTRY: +1 To Wound (Range or Shoot)
Long_Description:
At the start of your Movement phase, select one of the following:

Defensive Footing: Select one objective marker you control. Until the start of your next Movement phase, that objective marker is your Vowed objective marker.

Aggressive Push: Select one or more objective markers you do not control. Until the start of your next Movement phase, each of those objective markers is one of your Vowed objective markers. If a rule refers to a unit or model being within range of your Vowed objective marker, that rule takes effect if that unit or model is within range of one or more of your Vowed objective markers.

Each time a DEATHWING INFANTRY unit from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of one or more of your Vowed objective markers, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Short_Description: INFANTRY and MOUNTED -1 To Wound if weapons higher than Strength
Long_Description: Each time an attack targets an Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Short_Description:
RANGE: ASSAULT and +1 Strength within 12"
Infernus can Advance + Action OR Shoot and Action
Long_Description:
Ranged weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ASTARTES models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability, and each time an attack made with such a weapon targets a unit within 12", add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

If your army includes VULKAN HE’STAN, during your turn, each INFERNUS SQUAD unit from your army is eligible to do one of the following:
Start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.
Shoot in a turn in which it started to perform an Action.

Short_Description:
Ravenwing: Desperate Escape -1 when falling back.
Deathwing: +2 to Charge if Ravenwing in Engagement.
Long_Description:
Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of one or more RAVENWING units from your army Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

Each time a DEATHWING unit from your army declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more RAVENWING units from your army, add 2 to the Charge roll.

Short_Description: RAVENWING FLY units' ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
Long_Description:
Friendly RAVENWING FLY units' ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

RESTRICTIONS: Your army can include DARK ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

Long_Description: Ranged weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ASTARTES models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability, and each time an attack made with such a weapon targets a unit within 12", add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

Short_Description: CHAPLAIN: Destroy a unit = Force Battle-shock. Also, -1 LD within 6".
Long_Description:
In the Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit destroys an enemy unit, enemy units within 6" of that CHAPLAIN unit make a battle-shock roll.

Friendly CHAPLAIN units have the following ability: Sower of Dread (Aura): While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, that enemy unit has -1 Ld.

Short_Description: Start of battle round:  - Biomancy: +2" M.   - Divination: Re-roll 1s To Hit and To Wound - Pyromancy: Ranged within 12" have +1 AP - Telekinesis: Enemy Range -1 S.   - Telepathy: Ignore mods to BS, WS and hits.
Long_Description:
At the start of the battle round, select one of the following Psychic Disciplines abilities. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units have that ability until the end of the battle round:

Biomancy Discipline: This unit has +2" M.
Divination Discipline: This unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Pyromancy Discipline: This unit's ranged attacks that target an enemy unit within 12" of this unit have +1 AP.
Telekinesis Discipline: Ranged attacks that target this unit have -1 S.
Telepathy Discipline: This unit's attacks can ignore modifiers to BS, WS and hit rolls.

Short_Description:
PHOBOS and SCOUT detect a visible enemy within 12". 
While detected, enemy has +3" detection range.
Long_Description: Friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD units have the following ability. Transhuman Perception: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is detected. While a unit is detected, that unit has +3" detection range.

Short_Description: The Unforgiven: Adeptus Astartes become Dark Angels.
Long_Description:
The Unforgiven
If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that units Chapter. For example, Asmodai has both the ADEPTUS ASTARTES and DARK ANGELS Faction keywords, and is therefore from the Dark Angels Chapter.
You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

The Ravenwing
The following ADEPTUS ASTARTES units gain the RAVENWING keyword if they are drawn from the Dark Angels Chapter:
MOUNTED units VEHICLE units that can FLY

The Deathwing
The following ADEPTUS ASTARTES units gain the DEATHWING keyword if they are drawn from the Dark Angels Chapter:
TERMINATOR units
BLADEGUARD ANCIENT, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD and VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD WITH JUMP PACKS units
LAND RAIDER, LAND RAIDER CRUSADER, LAND RAIDER REDEEMER, REPULSOR and REPULSOR EXECUTIONER units
DREADNOUGHT units

TERMINATORS only
Go back to RESERVES

RESTRICTIONS: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Armour of Contempt Stratagem in the same phase.

Short_Description: SHOOTING: After a PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot, its ranged attacks do not prevent the unit from remaining hidden.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot.

TARGET: That PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

Short_Description:
Shoot 12" away = +1 BS and -1 AP
Also, Battle Shock.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit that is more than 12" away, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Short_Description:
Enemy 12" away +1 BS and AP.
If destroyed model, Battle Shock
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit that is more than 12" away, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1. 

If one or more enemy models are destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Short_Description: Unit gets PRECISION
Long_Description:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

Short_Description:
If Strengths is higher or equal
-1 To Wound.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Short_Description:
ADVANCE + SHOOT + CHARGE
If RAVENWING, also if Fell Back
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. 

If your unit has the RAVENWING keyword, it is also eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Short_Description: CHAPLAIN: Charge non-MONSTER and non-VEHICLE. Take LD test.  On a failure, -1 To Hit until the end of the turn.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That CHAPLAIN unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit, excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units, engaged with your unit. That enemy unit makes a leadership roll. If that leadership roll fails, that enemy unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls until the end of the turn.

Short_Description: Pick a different doctrine for the unit.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select the Devastator Doctrine, Tactical Doctrine or Assault Doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for that unit instead of any other Combat Doctrine that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that doctrine this battle.

Short_Description: Deathwing INFANTRY (Ranged):  -1 To be wounded if Higher Strength
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DEATHWING INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than your unit’s Toughness characteristic, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Short_Description: CHAPLAIN in enemy Move: After enemy falls back, Chaplain unit makes a normal move of up to D3+3".
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly CHAPLAIN unit ends a fall-back move, if that CHAPLAIN unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That CHAPLAIN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Short_Description: ENEMY SHOOTING: After an enemy has shot, one targeted unengaged RAVENWING FLY unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged RAVENWING FLY unit has shot.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Short_Description:
INFANTRY or MOUNTED
Reactive move up to 6".
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Short_Description: ENEMY SHOOTING: When targeted, one RAVENWING FLY unit has Stealth.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly RAVENWING FLY unit.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Stealth.

Short_Description: End of enemy Fight. MOUNTED or FLY VEHICLE not in Engagement goes into Strategic Reserves.
Long_Description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY VEHICLE unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Short_Description: Deathwing INFANTRY (Charges): Mortals per model on a 4+ Max 3 Mortals.   VOWED OBJ = 3+ Max 3 Mortal Wounds
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One DEATHWING INFANTRY unit from your army that just ended a Charge move.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit, adding 1 to the result if that enemy unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 3 mortal wounds).

Short_Description:
TERMINATORS & VETS
Sticky objectives
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any phase.

Short_Description: Infantry Shoots after Falls Back.
Long_Description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Short_Description: Opponent Shooting/Fight: targeted ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit worsens incoming AP by 1.
Long_Description: WHEN: Opponent Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.  TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army selected as a target of that enemy unit.  EFFECT: Until that enemy unit finishes its attacks, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of attacks that target your unit by 1.

Short_Description: Shooting/Fight: INFANTRY +1 To Wound closest eligible target within 6 inches.
Long_Description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.  TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.  EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, attacks made by models in your unit against the closest eligible target within 6 inches get +1 to the Wound roll.

Short_Description: Shooting: Torrent weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
Long_Description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase.  TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.  EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

Short_Description: Enemy Shooting: targeted TRANSPORT lets one embarked unit disembark and shoot only the attacker.
Long_Description: WHEN: Opponent Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.  TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit from your army that was targeted by one or more of those attacks.  EFFECT: One unit embarked within that TRANSPORT can disembark as if it were your Movement phase, then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. It must target only that enemy unit and can do so only if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Short_Description: Once per phase per ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: re-roll one Hit, Wound, or Damage roll.
Long_Description: Once per phase for each ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit in your army, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

Short_Description: Command: TECHMARINE selects VEHICLE 6", gain [LETHAL HITS] until next Command.
Long_Description: TECHMARINE model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 6 inches. Until the start of your next Command phase, weapons equipped by that model have [LETHAL HITS].

Short_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES: Feel No Pain 4+.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has Feel No Pain 4+.

Short_Description: Once per battle round: failed save for VEHICLE within 6"; Damage becomes 0.
Long_Description: TECHMARINE model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 6 inches, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

Short_Description: Command: VEHICLE within 6" to shoot after Advance or Falling Back until next Command.
Long_Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 6 inches. Until the start of your next Command phase, that VEHICLE can shoot even if it Advanced or Fell Back this turn.

Short_Description: Command: below Starting Strength; ignore characteristic, roll, and test modifiers except saving throws until end of turn.
Long_Description: WHEN: Command phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit below Starting Strength. EFFECT: Until end of turn, that unit can ignore modifiers to its characteristics and to rolls or tests made for it, except modifiers to saving throws.

Short_Description: Opponent Shooting/Fight: targeted ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit worsens incoming AP by 1.
Long_Description: WHEN: Opponent Shooting phase or Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects targets. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected as a target. EFFECT: Until that attacking unit finishes its attacks, worsen the AP of attacks targeting your unit by 1.

Short_Description: Shooting/Fight: vs below Starting Strength gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; VEHICLE Critical Hits on unmodified 5+.
Long_Description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that has not shot or fought this phase. EFFECT: Against targets below Starting Strength, attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; VEHICLE attacks also score Critical Hits on successful unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

Short_Description: Destroyed VEHICLE with Deadly Demise: automatically inflict its Deadly Demise mortal wounds.
Long_Description: WHEN: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE with Deadly Demise is destroyed. TARGET: That destroyed model. EFFECT: Do not roll to see whether Deadly Demise triggers; its mortal wounds are inflicted automatically.

Short_Description: Command: WALKER gets +1 Move, Toughness, Leadership, OC and +1 to Hit until next Command.
Long_Description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES WALKER model. EFFECT: Until your next Command phase, improve Move, Toughness, Leadership and Objective Control by 1, and add 1 to Hit rolls for its attacks.

Short_Description: Opponent Shooting: VEHICLE reduced below Half-strength can shoot back only at the attacker.
Long_Description: WHEN: Opponent Shooting phase, after an enemy unit resolves its attacks. TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit reduced to Below Half-strength by those attacks. EFFECT: That unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but only at that enemy unit and only if it is an eligible target.
